answer.summary: API Types Check failed because the generated TypeScript types are stale: regenerating from the API adds new Page*Output interfaces (e.g. PageCatalogScenarioOutput) that are not committed. The branch changed the catalog API, so the committed types must be regenerated and pushed. A re-run on the same commit will fail the same way.

evidence.quote: ⚠️ Forgot to generate types! Please run 'yarn run generate-types-from-api' before committing.
